description: Pocket security multi-tool for Cardputer Zero: Wi-Fi capture and wardriving, sub-GHz sweep and raw OOK capture, NFC probe, drone/ALPR surveillance sniffing, Meshtastic and MeshCore mesh modes.

store.description: LokiCZ turns a Cardputer Zero and its radio caps into a pocket security lab. With a USB Wi-Fi dongle it captures WPA handshakes (passive, deauth-free); it wardrives to WiGLE-format CSV; the CC1101 cap sweeps 433/915 MHz, records raw OOK remote signals to Flipper .sub files, and probes the cap's ST25R3916 NFC frontend; a passive sniffer flags drone Remote ID and known surveillance-device fingerprints over Wi-Fi and BLE; and the LoRa cap runs Meshtastic or MeshCore under one supervisor — one radio, one owner. Built for your own lab gear and networks you are authorized to test.
store.summary: Pocket security multi-tool: capture, wardrive, sub-GHz, NFC, mesh
